My vision for this subverse is to have it focus primarily on sharing links to content which can be streamed (e.g. via [PLEX](https://plex.tv/)) or discussion of apps/services that provide content.

**COOL**

*Video*: Please do share long-form content (e.g. movies, documentaries, TV shows, concert-length videos, etc.). Random, short-form videos (e.g. "viral videos" ) *should not be posted*. Short-form content should only be posted if it is part of a series. An example of this would be posting a link to an episode of Tim Heidecker's "On Cinema" would be fine, but a random 5 minute video of something funny would not. Porn videos are not appropriate, however, links to adult channels playable on streaming devices are okay.

*Apps/Services*: This is a broad category, but basically includes apps/channels found on cord-cutting devices (e.g. Roku, AppleTV, Xbox One, etc.) Two examples would be [Full Moon Streaming ](http://fullmoonstreaming.com/index)or [Warner Brothers Archive](http://instant.warnerarchive.com/). If you know what devices support the channel you are sharing, please include that.

**NOT COOL**

*Links to pirate sites* (e.g. websites with newly released films, torrent sites, et.al.). I don't want this sub to endanger Voat or /u/atko so please be cool about this and try and use some discretion. If the content is hosted on well-known sites like YouTube or Vimeo then it's OK. If it is content that can accessed via a reputable app like [Channel Pear](https://channelpear.com/), then that's OK. If it's just some webpage with pirated movies then that's not cool. I'm not passing judgement, just wanting to keep Voat out of the crosshairs of people who would seek to hurt it.

*Videos advancing a politically partisan or racist agenda are not allowed*. You're free to hold your opinions, but this subverse should not be used to spread racial or political ideology. If you have a question regarding the propriety of a link, just PM me.

**IF YOU VISIT THE SUB, PLEASE TRY TO SUBMIT AT LEAST ONE LINK.** :)
